name: Unitree H1-2
summary: Full-size 70 kg humanoid with 7-DOF arms rated for about 7 kg each, for manipulation and locomotion research.

germany.statusNote: Generation Robots lists the H1-2 as a version on its H1 page, price and delivery on request; OpenELAB lists it at 138,283.95 € incl. VAT but sold out, shipping from China.

priceEur.note: OpenELAB, incl. VAT; sold out at the check.

sellers.name: Generation Robots (Génération Robots, with Generation Robots GmbH in Berlin)
sellers.note: H1-2 selectable on the H1 / H1-2 page; the shop returns the same from-price for the H1-2 as for the H1 (EUR 93,496 excl. VAT), so it shows no separate H1-2 price; cart disabled, delivery on request.

sellers.name: OpenELAB (OpenELAB Technology Ltd., Shenzhen; office in Garching bei München)
sellers.note: "Ausverkauft" (sold out); ships from China or via its EU office; returns may go to the US, Germany or China; 12-month limited warranty.

specs.label: Arm load
specs.conditions: rated about 7 kg; peak about 21 kg

specs.label: Computing
specs.value: Intel Core i5 (platform) + Intel Core i7 (user development); optional Orin NX, up to 3 devices

capabilities.sdk: Intel Core i7 user development computer
notes: No IP rating or runtime published.

images.alt: Unitree H1-2 humanoid robot, upper body

openQuestions: Runtime: Unitree's H1-2 manual (page images only) says about 2 h; no HTML page states it.
Unitree states "Arm normal load … Rated: about 7 kg" without saying per arm or both arms; the record reads it as per arm.
